recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source edit is needed for FHIR-13059; review of the related venue clarification should use the existing FHIR-14233 reconcile record rather than duplicating it here.
issue_request: FHIR-13059 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for DSTU2 asking that Usage Context type codes stop describing possible value sets only by OID and instead define or locate FHIR value sets for those context types. The accepted resolution was that example value sets would be defined for each usage context type.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN 11663, imported as git commit 08d280b8e8593f627923e0cade06a02eea8d7d2b (#13059: Example value sets for use contexts). That commit changed source/datatypes/usagecontext.xml and source/terminologies/valueset-use-context.xml to add a UsageContextValue example binding plus FHIR value set URLs and compose inclusions for the relevant usage context examples.
additional_context: UsageContext is active in source/fhir.ini [types] and mapped to the metadatatypes page. Current source/datatypes/usagecontext.xml binds UsageContext.code to the THO usage-context-type value set and UsageContext.value[x] to the FHIR use-context example value set. Later FHIR-14233 relaxed the language so the value set references are clearly examples and changed venue to ServiceDeliveryLocationRoleType; FHIR-13091 was closed Resolved - No Change because that venue change had already been made elsewhere.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current UsageContext spreadsheet, valueset-use-context terminology source, and additional bindings already preserve the FHIR-13059 outcome after later clarifications.
